implementation_notes: Concept images only. Preserve independent geometric silhouettes and single-hand grip. Surface grain in illustrations does not request new stone or metal textures; eventual models use existing geometric emissive materials and reduced glow. Stats not yet specified. Purple final uses continuous upper arch with open lower sector.

concepts.name: 余烬·裂冠
concepts.design: Crimson and coral red asymmetric broad axe. One wide wedge-shaped cleaving blade projects left, with a crisp curved polygonal cutting edge and thick base. Upper blunt rear of head steps downward in three broken crown-like rectangular terraces to right. A triangular negative-space opening close to socket, robust joins. Short straight dark red octagonal shaft and small angular pommel. Fierce top-heavy compact silhouette; red geometric ember flecks.

concepts.name: 流萤·萦枝
concepts.design: Emerald and mint green crescent war axe. Two thick smooth polygonal curved structural bands interweave in depth, joined at socket and blade, making a large open crescent-shaped axe head with clearly empty windows. The forward crescent has a broad solid sharp cutting surface, not a thin wire. Compact sweeping silhouette, no actual leaves or vines. Gently curved medium short jade shaft with straight comfortable lower grip, mint lozenge motes in hollow head.

concepts.name: 寒汐·断湾
concepts.design: Petrol blue and icy cyan angular war axe. Broad squared cleaving blade with a long angular cutting edge on left and stepped lower beard extending downward. A deep bay-shaped rectangular negative-space recess opens inward between lower beard and shaft, clearly C-shaped head with substantial thickness and strong upper socket connection. Compact architectural silhouette, medium short straight blue shaft, rectangular pommel, sparse cyan short dash particles in bay.

concepts.name: 梦隙·缺轮
concepts.design: Dark violet and pale orchid war axe. An incomplete thick irregular polygonal ring forms compact head with generous hollow center and a clearly visible missing lower-right sector. Left/front segment is expanded into a broad solid convex axe cutting blade; other ring segments are narrow supportive angular beams, connected to top of shaft on right. Asymmetric open-ring silhouette, substantial slab depth, no floating structural pieces. Medium short straight purple handle and angular pommel, a few lavender triangular fragments around open ring.

concepts.edit_prompt: Edit this purple axe concept only to fix structural continuity. Preserve full composition, purple palette, handle, left broad blade, and large central empty opening. Join the upper arc continuously into the right-hand socket above handle: close the thin diagonal crack at 3 o'clock with solid purple material. Remove the floating large diamond at 12 o'clock and replace it with a solid continuous polygonal arch joining left blade to right arc. Keep the LARGE lower gap at 6 o'clock between left blade tip and right socket OPEN so it remains a C-shaped incomplete ring axe. All load bearing head components must now be one connected solid assembly attached to shaft. Tiny surrounding triangular particle flecks may remain floating. Clean opaque geometric surface, no cracks or stone grain. No text.
